item.title: Made for the cold: World Cup ice climbing returns to Edmonton
item.description: Edmonton hosted the 2026 UIAA Ice Climbing World Cup Feb. 26-28, bringing elite athletes from around the world to the North Saskatchewan River valley. Hosted at Louise McKinney Riverfront Park, the event served as the final round of the global World Cup season. Competitors from Canada, Czechia, France, Germany, Britain, Hong Kong-China, Iran, Ireland, Japan, […]

item.title: Death of elderly man in Ponoka County confirmed homicide
item.description: A 92-year-old man has died in what police are now treating as a homicide in Ponoka County. RCMP located a man outside his residence on Tuesday and the major crimes unit is investigating. An autopsy on Thursday confirmed the death was a result of foul play.
